SR-001.justification: Three FreeBSD (hdrlen 26) and three macOS (hdrlen 18) records are read back; hdrlen below the minimum, caplen past the buffer and every header cut end the parse; a final record shorter than the padded struct is read; 50 000 random buffers with both layouts stay inside; Miri clean; fuzzed 20 s locally without a finding.

SR-002.justification: With a second thread the call returns "1 other thread(s) still hold capabilities"; alone it succeeds, every /proc/self/task/*/status shows zero CapInh/CapPrm/CapEff/CapAmb and NoNewPrivs 1, CapBnd lacks bits 12 and 13 (root in Docker held CAP_SETPCAP), the socket still sends and receives, and a new socket is refused naming CAP_NET_RAW.

SR-003.justification: Exhaustive over flags x tx_type 0..=3 x rx_filter 0..=15 - a write keeps flags and tx_type and only changes NONE to ALL; an unreadable configuration gives Software and no write (decide(None)); on veth (no hwtstamp ioctl) the socket reports Software. The linux backend writes only on Plan::Widen (review of hardware_timestamps).

SR-004.justification: On ring and plain paths (Docker, 2026-11-09) a recv with a 5 s timeout returns an error naming the interface within 1 s of link down or deletion; after link up a frame is received; after deletion a later recv does not spin.

SR-005.justification: A cmsg whose cmsg_len is shorter than [timespec; 3] is skipped and a full-length one read (Linux unit tests in Docker); MSG_CTRUNC causes every message to be ignored in plain_next and drain_error_queue (review, src/sys/linux.rs).

SR-006.evidence: src/sys/linux.rs (Ring::block returns &[u8]; Ring::frame_mut borrows only start-4..start+len; ring_next); Miri on ring and vlan tests
SR-006.justification: The walker reads through Ring::block (shared); VLAN re-insertion gets a &mut over the frame and its head-room only; Miri reports no UB on the pure ring/vlan modules.

SR-007.justification: The MAC is copied with ptr::copy_nonoverlapping from ifa_addr.cast::<u8>() + offset_of!(sockaddr_dl, sdl_data) + sdl_nlen, bounded by sdl_len; no &sockaddr_dl spans the read; the macOS lo0 test still opens.

SR-008.justification: Duration::MAX gives no deadline and recv returns; overflowing ring geometries are InvalidInput; a ja with k = u32::MAX is refused and run uses checked_add; clippy passes on i686.

SR-009.justification: RxMode::Ring with a 2 KiB block (not a page multiple) fails open with InvalidInput on both runs; Auto keeps its fallback (review of open).

SR-010.justification: On FreeBSD without see_outgoing, BIOCSDIRECTION (0x80044277 = _IOW('B', 119, u_int), checked against FreeBSD's bpf.h) is issued with BPF_D_IN and its error returned; builds with clippy for x86_64-unknown-freebsd.

SR-011.justification: Classification by origin and code is unit-tested; the veth assertion missed >= 1 runs only where the kernel has sch_etf (GitHub's ubuntu-24.04), not in Docker Desktop. Verify with the CI run.

SR-012.evidence: src/sys/bsd.rs (recv increments delivered; stats returns delivered and bs_drop); src/packet.rs Stats rustdoc
SR-012.justification: received counts records handed out by recv, all of which passed the in-kernel filter; dropped is bs_drop; the rustdoc states the meaning and what is excluded. bd_rcount being pre-filter was read in FreeBSD and xnu bpf.c (research R9).
